body.message:
Following up again.

We have provided all required details and confirmed the account earlier today.

As of now, there is still no confirmation that the transfer has been initiated.

Please note that this matter is already under review with DET, and we will be updating the case to reflect the continued delay in processing the refund.

At this stage, there are no outstanding items from our side, and no valid justification for any deductions.

We expect confirmation that the FULL refund of AED 17,675 has been initiated today.

Kindly confirm immediately and share the payment confirmation.
